title: Shinkansen to Osaka — Street Food Capital
description: Board the bullet train to Osaka in 2.5 hours. Osaka is Japan's kitchen — tonight: Dotonbori, the most electric food street in the world.

activities.title: Shinkansen to Osaka
activities.description: Take the Tokaido Shinkansen from Tokyo Station to Shin-Osaka. Watch Japan's countryside and Mt. Fuji fly past at 300km/h.
details: 🚅 Sit right side (seats D/E) for Mt. Fuji view
🍱 Grab an ekiben (station bento) — it's a ritual
🎫 JR Pass: take Hikari (2h50m). Without: Nozomi (~¥14,000)
📍 Transfer to local line to Namba — your Osaka base

tips.text: Stay near Namba or Dotonbori — walking distance to best food streets and easy subway access everywhere.

activities.title: Shinsekai & Tsutenkaku Tower
activities.description: Osaka's retro entertainment district frozen in time from the 1950s. Colorful signs, kushikatsu shops everywhere, and the iconic Tsutenkaku Tower.
details: 🍢 Kushikatsu Daruma — never double-dip in the communal sauce!
🗼 Tsutenkaku Tower — rub Billiken's feet for good luck
🎮 Retro game arcades everywhere — perfect for families

meals.name: Kushikatsu Daruma
meals.description: Deep-fried skewers of everything: shrimp, beef, cheese, lotus root. Dip once in communal sauce, never twice.

activities.title: Dotonbori Food Street Extravaganza
activities.description: Sensory overload of neon signs, giant mechanical crabs, and food stalls along the canal. Eat takoyaki, okonomiyaki, and gyoza until you can't move.
details: 🐙 Takoyaki — try Wanaka or Creo-ru
🥞 Okonomiyaki — Osaka-style, made right in front of you
🦀 Kani Doraku giant crab sign — Dotonbori's most iconic photo
🏃 Glico Running Man sign — THE Osaka photo on Ebisubashi Bridge

meals.name: Dotonbori Street Food Crawl
meals.description: Don't sit down — graze your way through. Takoyaki, okonomiyaki, gyoza, finish with Rikuro's cheesecake.

title: Osaka Castle, Markets & Wagyu Night
description: Explore Osaka's historic heart — the magnificent castle, Kuromon Market for fresh seafood, Den-Den Town for car hobby shops, and a splurge wagyu dinner.

activities.title: Osaka Castle & Nishinomaru Garden
activities.description: One of Japan's most iconic castles. The grounds are massive — moats, stone walls, and gardens. Inside, the museum covers Osaka's feudal history.
details: 🏯 Arrive early (9am) for Golden Week crowds
📸 Best photo from Gokurakubashi Bridge with castle reflection
🏛️ Castle museum is 8 floors — elevator up, walk down

meals.name: Kuromon Market
meals.description: "Osaka's Kitchen" — 170+ stalls. Grilled king crab, fresh uni, tuna sashimi, matcha soft serve. Eat as you walk.

activities.title: Den-Den Town — Car Shops & Retro Games
activities.description: Osaka's version of Akihabara, less touristy with better car culture shops. Scale models, retro games, and automotive hobby stores.
details: 🏎️ Joshin Super Kids Land — massive hobby shop with die-cast cars
🎮 Retro game stores — Initial D cabinets
🚗 Up Garage Osaka — used JDM parts at great prices

activities.title: Shinsaibashi Shopping Arcade
activities.description: 600-meter covered shopping street. Boutiques, street fashion, and drugstores — great for families.
details: 🛍️ Mix of international brands and quirky Japanese shops
💊 Don Quijote — stock up on Japanese skincare and snacks

activities.title: Umeda Sky Building Sunset
activities.description: Two towers connected by a floating garden observatory 173m up. Night views of Osaka's sprawling lights are spectacular.
details: 🌃 Visit at sunset for blue hour to night
📸 Glow-in-the-dark floor tiles on the rooftop
🍽️ Takimi Koji basement — 1920s Osaka street recreation with restaurants

meals.name: Matsusakagyu Yakiniku M
meals.description: Premium Matsusaka beef yakiniku — one of Japan's top three wagyu brands. Melt-in-your-mouth marbling, grilled tableside.

mapPins.label: Osaka Castle
mapPins.desc: Iconic castle with museum and park

mapPins.label: Den-Den Town
mapPins.desc: Car hobby shops and retro games

title: Kyoto Day Trip — Temples, Gates & Bamboo
description: Day trip to Kyoto — 15 minutes by Shinkansen from Osaka. Hit the three icons: Fushimi Inari's torii gates, Kinkaku-ji's golden pavilion, and Arashiyama's bamboo groves.

activities.title: Fushimi Inari Taisha — 10,000 Torii Gates
activities.description: Thousands of vermillion torii gates wind up a forested mountain. The full hike takes 2-3 hours, but even 30 minutes is breathtaking.
details: ⛩️ Arrive by 7:30am — by 9am it's packed during Golden Week
🥾 Full loop to summit is 4km — manageable but hilly
📸 Gates thin out after first intersection — best photos there
🦊 Fox statues everywhere — Inari's divine messengers

tips.text: Golden Week + Kyoto = massive crowds. Arrive before 8am at Fushimi Inari. Arashiyama calms down by afternoon.

activities.title: Kinkaku-ji — The Golden Pavilion
activities.description: A Zen temple covered entirely in gold leaf, reflecting in its mirror pond. Looks even better in person. Quick 30-45 min visit but essential.
details: 📸 Reflection shot from across the pond is the classic angle
🎫 Entry ticket is an omamori charm — keep it
🍵 Matcha and sweets in the garden tea area

meals.name: Nishiki Market
meals.description: "Kyoto's Kitchen" — 130+ shops with pickles, mochi, fresh tofu, matcha everything, and grilled snacks.

activities.title: Arashiyama Bamboo Grove & Monkey Park
activities.description: Walk through towering bamboo forest — another world. Climb to the Monkey Park where wild macaques roam with Kyoto as the backdrop.
details: 🎋 Bamboo path is 15 min walk — explore Tenryu-ji temple too
🐒 Iwatayama Monkey Park — 170+ wild macaques, kids love it
⏰ 20-min uphill walk, panoramic Kyoto view at top

activities.title: Return to Osaka
activities.description: Take the JR train back (30-45 min). You've earned a big dinner after a full day of temples.

meals.name: Okonomiyaki Mizuno
meals.description: Legendary okonomiyaki right on Dotonbori. The yamaiimo okonomiyaki is impossibly fluffy.

title: Shinkansen to Nagoya — Toyota's Hometown
description: Children's Day! Head to Nagoya — the automotive heart of Japan. Toyota, Mitsubishi, and countless parts makers call this region home.

activities.title: Shinkansen to Nagoya
activities.description: Quick 50-minute bullet train from Shin-Osaka to Nagoya. Look for koinobori (carp streamers) flying for Children's Day.
details: 🚅 Hikari or Kodama, covered by JR Pass
🎏 Children's Day — koinobori everywhere
📍 Stay near Nagoya Station or Sakae

activities.title: Osu Shopping District
activities.description: Nagoya's Akihabara meets Harajuku — covered arcade with retro vibes, anime shops, and car culture stores.
details: 🛕 Osu Kannon Temple at the entrance
🚗 Car model shops — Toyota and Nissan collectibles goldmine
🎮 Retro game centers and manga cafés

activities.title: Oasis 21 & TV Tower
activities.description: Futuristic transit hub with glass 'Water Spaceship' roof. Adjacent is Japan's oldest TV tower.
details: 📸 Glass roof reflects the sky — glows at night
🗼 TV Tower observation deck for 360° views

meals.name: Yamamotoya Honten
meals.description: Nagoya's signature miso nikomi udon — thick noodles in rich red miso broth in a clay pot. Since 1925.

activities.title: Sakae District Night Walk
activities.description: Nagoya's main entertainment district — department stores, izakaya, and nightlife. More relaxed than Tokyo.
details: 🏮 Side streets full of izakaya
🎮 Round1 — arcade, bowling, karaoke
🌃 TV Tower lit up at night

meals.name: Sekai no Yamachan
meals.description: Nagoya's famous tebasaki — crispy peppery chicken wings. Order a mountain with draft beer. Family-friendly and fun.

title: Toyota Museum Day — Where Cars Were Born
description: The pilgrimage every car lover must make. The Toyota Museum traces how a loom maker became the world's biggest car company. Then Toyota City for the Kaikan Museum.

activities.title: 🏎️ Toyota Commemorative Museum of Industry and Technology
activities.description: Automotive Mecca. In Toyota's original 1911 factory — vintage cars, working engines, assembly line demos, and the Technoland play area for kids.
details: 🏭 Red-brick factory — the architecture is stunning
🧵 Textile Pavilion — original looms that funded the car business
🚗 Automobile Pavilion — vintage Toyotas, concepts, working assembly line
⚙️ Live demos of engines, transmissions, stamping presses
👶 Technoland — hands-on science area for kids
🎫 Only ¥500 — absurdly good value
⏰ Allow 3+ hours minimum

meals.name: Kishimen at Nagoya Station
meals.description: Nagoya's signature flat udon in dashi broth with bonito flakes. Light and refreshing after museum-going.
meals.meta: 💰 ¥800 · 📍 Eki Kishimen at Nagoya Station platform

tips.text: Car fans spend 4+ hours here. Technoland keeps younger kids busy while adults geek out over engines.

activities.title: 🏎️ Toyota Kaikan Museum — Toyota City
activities.description: Take the train to Toyota City (1 hour) for Toyota's corporate museum. Latest models, safety tech, hydrogen fuel cells, and racing vehicles.
details: 🚗 Current production models and concept cars
🏁 Racing heritage — Le Mans, WRC, Formula 1
🤖 Robot demonstrations
🎫 Free entry
🚃 Meitetsu line from Nagoya — ~1 hour

activities.title: Atsuta Shrine & Hitsumabushi
activities.description: Visit one of Japan's most sacred Shinto shrines, then the city's most famous dish: hitsumabushi — grilled eel eaten three ways.

meals.name: Atsuta Horaiken
meals.description: The original hitsumabushi since 1873. Charcoal-grilled eel, eaten three ways: plain, with condiments, then with dashi broth poured over.

mapPins.label: Atsuta Shrine
mapPins.desc: One of Japan's most important shrines
